Text-geometry defects detected in Unit 1 SVG figure assets. Running node scripts/measure-figure-text.mjs static/img/figures/gnas-301/unit-01/*.svg reports 10 text geometry issues across four figures: (1) fig-U1-2.dark.svg and fig-U1-2.svg spill 21.4px out of panel [30,56,750,96] ("One Sindh classroom example"); (2) fig-U1-3.ur.dark.svg and fig-U1-3.ur.svg overprint the wordmark (ends 180, wordmark starts 12) ("مسائل (رنگین تیر)"); (3) fig-U1-6.dark.svg and fig-U1-6.svg have overlapping text (11.2px) between "withdrawals already highly stressed" and "stay below renewal: quotas", and "Management response" spills 7.7px out of panel [26,50,754,88]; (4) fig-U1-8.dark.svg and fig-U1-8.svg have overlapping text (4.8px) between "In the community" and "name the local issue and its". These defects must be corrected in SVG source files in a graphics repair pass before G3 certification.
